data.name: Wild West Gunslinger
data.detailed_description:
Dust fills the sky. Gunfire never ceases. In this Western world where law has failed and only the strong survive, you will step into the boots of a bounty hunter, plunging into fight after fight for survival.

Built as a top-down roguelike shooter, the game offers hundreds of weapons and skills to freely mix and match — every run is a one-of-a-kind combat experience. Against waves of wolves, bandits, and colossal bosses, you must fire on the move and counterattack while dodging, savoring the ultimate power fantasy of bullets flying and explosions tearing across the screen.

Sunsets, railroads, wanted posters — a living, breathing Western world.

Play as a bounty hunter walking the edge of the law, traversing vast desert towns and taking on deadly bounties. Every character carries their own past and obsessions; every battle is fought for survival and vengeance. The hand-drawn art style captures the bleak, deadly atmosphere of the West — immersing you in a classic Western film, where you live out the thrill and romance of a life on the run.

 

Six distinct bounty hunters. Six radically different combat styles.

From a federal lawman to a mysterious female gunslinger, from a heavyweight brawler to a nimble assassin — each character boasts unique stats, weapon systems, and skill trees. Collect gear, unlock abilities, and craft your build during each run; upgrade characters, enhance stats, and unlock new content between runs. A deep progression system paired with high replayability ensures every fresh start brims with new possibilities and strategic depth.

 

The Wild West. Live by the gun.

In a land soaked in dust and blood, only the fastest draw and the hardest fist survive till the end. Wild West Gunslinger thrusts you into a lawless frontier — charge into battle atop ferocious beasts, unleash dual pistols to clear the field, and carve a path through a hail of bullets. Every firefight is the ultimate test of reflexes and courage. Are you ready to draw?

 

Built as a top-down roguelike shooter, the game offers hundreds of weapons and skills to freely combine — every run delivers a fresh combat experience. Face waves of wolves, bandits, and colossal bosses; fire on the move, counterattack while dodging, and revel in the ultimate power fantasy of bullets flying and explosions rocking the screen. Random loot, in-run upgrades, and build crafting — the longer you survive, the stronger and more satisfying it gets.
